title: Chatgpt V-Taper v2
author: Mainframe
desc:
Program Philosophy

Built for:

V-taper
Aesthetics
Hypertrophy
Strength

Priority muscles:

Lats
Side Delts
Upper Chest
Triceps
Mid Back
Biceps

Schedule:

Monday: Upper A
Tuesday: Lower A
Wednesday: Rest
Thursday: Upper B
Friday: Lower B
Saturday: Arms + Delts
Sunday: Rest

ex.note:
Setup: 
Bench 30°
Feet planted
Shoulder blades down and back

Cue:
Lower elbows slightly below bench level
Press up and slightly inward
Chest up

Rest 3 min

Grip: Neutral

Setup: 
Thigh pad tight
Chest up
Slight lean back (~10°)

Cue:
Let shoulders rise at top
Pull elbows into front pockets
Drive elbows, not hands

Rest 2 min

Setup:
Chest glued to pad
Seat adjusted so chest is supported comfortably

Cue:
Reach at stretch
Pull elbows toward hips
Avoid shrugging

Rest 2 min

Setup:
Handles at mid-chest level
Seat adjusted so handles align with chest

Cue:
Stretch chest at bottom
Drive through palms
Keep shoulders down

Rest 2 mins

Setup: 
Single-arm
Pulley adjusted so cable is roughly 90° to arm during working range (Jeff cue)

Cue:
Lead with elbow
Raise to shoulder height
Control lowering

Rest 60 sec

Cue:
Full depth
Knees forward
Stay braced

Rest 3 min

Cue:
Push hips back
Soft knees
Stop at full hamstring stretch

Rest 3 min

Setup: 
Feet shoulder width

Cue: 
Full depth
Don't bounce

Rest 2 min

Setup:
Knee aligned with machine pivot

Cues:
Stretch fully
Curl hard

Rest 90 sec

Cue:
Full stretch
Pause at top

Rest 90 sec

Attachment: Rope

Cue:
Curl spine
Bring ribs toward pelvis

Rest 60 sec

Grip: Inner neutral handles

Cue:
Shoulders elevate at top
Pull elbows to hips
Full stretch

Rest 3 min

Setup:
Shoulder aligned with pivot

Cue:
Drive elbows down
Feel lats stretch

Rest 2 min

Attachment: Medium Neutral MAG/Rapid Motion

Cue:
Reach forward
Pull elbows to hips
Chest proud


Rest 2 min
